items.claim: [r57-1] Marks a shaper clusters onto a space, tab, or soft hyphen were never drawn
items.note: When a shaped cluster opens on a code point that layout measures itself (a space, a tab, a soft hyphen, a hard line break, or a color cluster), the cluster's other code points are now measured on their own too. Spaces, tabs, and hyphens keep their usual handling.

items.claim: [r57-2] A throw in `layoutRuns` while evicting a structural-list entry left that entry pointing at recycled columns
items.note: The entry being evicted is now made unmatchable before layout starts. `evictRunsForRefill` already did this, and both now use the same `blank` helper.

items.claim: [r57-3] A painting that threw left its groups in the slots, and the next painting took them over
items.note: Each painting now starts by emptying the slots (`openGroups`). The test showed the next text being drawn in the earlier text's fill.

items.claim: [r57-4] `outlineMinSize: NaN` was cached as "no outlines" but painted every glyph as an outline
items.note: This was a behavior call: `paintRuns` and `cachedPaintRuns` now throw a `RangeError` on `NaN`, and the renderer's `drawText` never passes a `NaN`. The call is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`; treating `NaN` as "omitted" was the alternative.

items.claim: `layoutEntries.ts` grew past the 400-line `check:size` cap after the r57-1 fix
items.note: `mirrorEntries` and `unshaped` moved into `mirrorEntries.ts`. This only repairs damage from my own change, so it is not counted as an extra defect.
→c246ebb99e — final sha c246ebb99e: scaled with the text, `bakeTextFit` included, the strict call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: a `{ px }` width scales too, as `{ px }` `fontSize` already does.

items.claim: Covered code point in an RTL cluster drawn twice
items.note: the covered slot does get un-shaped and mirrored, but `drawsInk` stays false, so every painter (`paintRuns`, `textToPath`, `textClusters`) skips it; ran a reproduction and only the cluster's glyph was drawn.

items.claim: Duplicate: "removed positions level 0" B is a
Code points handled before the shaped-slot check (space, tab, soft hyphen) throw away their shaped slot, so a mark clustered onto them is never drawn
A throw inside `layoutRuns` on a structural-list eviction leaves a listed entry pointing at recycled columns
A throw mid-painting leaves the group slots filled, and the next painting returns the previous one's groups, including one whose quadData is the shared scratch
`outlineMinSize: NaN` lands in the same paint-cache bucket as a threshold no run reaches, but paints every glyph as an outline
Shrink-to-fit scales a run's sizes but not its stroke width, so fitted stroked text gets heavier the more it shrinks
`JOINED_ENDS` grows to the longest text ever measured and never shrinks
